digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM structured Agent run and failure handling
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregated usage (sum of all attempts) in memory, telemetry, and exactly one durable JSONL row, never per-attempt rows.
Validation exhaustion must re-raise the identical original StructuredOutputError object by walking the __cause__ chain through UnexpectedModelBehavior -> ToolRetryError -> ModelRetry.
Repeated-truncation/concision exhaustion lacking a Rebar object in the cause chain must surface a freshly-constructed UnretryableOutputError as the defined fallback.
Unrelated UnexpectedModelBehavior exceptions (without 'Exceeded maximum output retries' marker) must remain untranslated.
Terminal failure artifacts must preserve the complete final provider response when artifact capture is enabled, without mutating stored messages from retry wire omission.
Consumed requests, tool calls, and provider-reported tokens must be retained in failure diagnostics without creating fictional usage for calls that reported none.
